name: Sign In App Scheduling (formerly 10to8)
description_en:
The original 10to8 website redirects to an official Sign In App page explaining that Sign In Scheduling is now part of Sign In App. The page says existing scheduling customers can continue using the same application and login. This is a product transition, not evidence that all visitor-management features were historically included in a 10to8 subscription.

The current scheduling journey can connect an appointment with visitor pre-registration, reminders, arrival and no-show tracking. This profile preserves that scheduling scope and distinguishes it from the wider workplace platform.
description_zh:
原 10to8 网站跳转到 Sign In App 官方说明，表示 Sign In Scheduling 已并入 Sign In App。页面说明现有排程客户可以继续使用原应用及登录。这是产品转变，不能证明 10to8 旧订阅原本包含所有访客管理能力。

当前排程流程可以关联预约、访客预登记、提醒、到访及未到场跟踪。本文保留排程范围，并与更广的办公平台区分。

core_features.explanation_en: Visitors can book, cancel and reschedule using booking links or a website.
core_features.explanation_zh: 访客可通过预约链接或网站预约、取消和改期。

core_features.explanation_en: Bookings can pre-register visitors and arrival information can identify no-shows.
core_features.explanation_zh: 预约可预登记访客，到场信息可用于识别未到场。

en: The official transition FAQ says existing credentials remain valid and names app.10to8.com as the continuing login. sections.title_en: Existing users and new buyers need different checks
sections.title_zh: 现有用户与新买家需要不同核对
sections.en:
The official transition FAQ says existing credentials remain valid and names app.10to8.com as the continuing login. That does not define every legacy contract entitlement or migrate all plans onto current platform pricing. Existing customers should verify their actual account before changing a booking workflow.

New buyers should examine the current Sign In App scheduling offer and site subscription. Preserve the original project slug as catalogue identity, while making the official product transition visible. No alternative relationship, ownership claim or publication approval is inferred from the redirect.
sections.zh:
官方过渡 FAQ 表示现有凭据继续有效，并列出 app.10to8.com 作为持续登录地址。这不定义所有旧合同权益，也不证明所有旧档位自动采用当前平台定价。现有客户改变预约流程前应核对自己的实际账户。

新买家应看当前 Sign In App 排程方案及站点订阅。目录保留原项目 slug 作为身份，同时说明官方产品转变；不会因跳转推定替代关系、所有者认领或发布通过。

sections.title_en: Example: an expected visitor with a booked host
sections.title_zh: 示例：已预约主持人的预期访客
sections.en:
A visitor selects a service and time, receives confirmation/reminders, and becomes a preregistered arrival. The host can receive visitor details; arrival and sign-in information can distinguish a kept appointment from a no-show. The appointment and physical visit are related records, not the same event.

Demonstrate a reschedule, a canceled visit and someone arriving without signing in. Check what the system marks as absent and which records staff see. This is an evaluation scenario, not a performed visitor test or proof that an automated no-show record always reflects physical absence.
sections.zh:
访客选择服务和时间，收到确认/提醒，并成为预登记到访者。主持人可接收访客资料，到场签到信息可区分完成到访与未到场。预约和实体到访是相关记录，不是同一个事件。

建议演示改期、取消，以及到达却未签到的人，核对系统如何标记缺席、员工看到哪些记录。这是评估场景，未实际测试访客，也不证明自动未到场记录总等于实体缺席。

sections.title_en: Current site pricing does not replace a legacy quote
sections.title_zh: 当前站点价格不会自动替代旧报价
sections.en:
The GBP pricing view lists Core at £415 per site per year, Enhanced £835 and Pro £1,255. The feature breakdown includes 2,400 scheduling appointments in Enhanced and 9,600 in Pro; the add-on section offers a 2,400-appointment yearly bundle for £360. The page describes 2,400 per year as equivalent to 200 monthly; that is not evidence of a strict monthly reset.

Each different postcode/zip-code location needs its own site subscription according to the FAQ. Additional hardware, shipping and other workplace modules are separate. New scheduling costs therefore depend on included capacity, extra bundles and sites, while the financial treatment of a legacy 10to8 account remains unverified. Obtain a dated quote for that account instead of presenting a platform base fee as its replacement price.
sections.zh:
英镑定价视图列出 Core 每站点每年 £415，Enhanced £835，Pro £1,255。功能明细给 Enhanced 2,400 次、Pro 9,600 次排程预约；附加项提供每年 2,400 次预约包，价格 £360。页面将每年 2,400 描述为月均 200，不证明严格按月重置。

FAQ 表示不同邮编地点各需站点订阅。硬件、运费及其他办公模块另计。因此新排程费用取决于包含容量、额外包和站点，旧 10to8 账户的财务处理仍未核实。应获取对应账户的有日期报价，不能把平台基础费当作旧价格的直接替代。

sections.title_en: Scope, identity and unresolved failure behavior
sections.title_zh: 范围、身份与未核实的失败行为
sections.en:
Prepare sites, services, hosts, calendar connections and visitor fields. Distinguish booking access from staff sign-in or evacuation permissions. Verify reminders and arrival matching before relying on no-show reports. If calendar writes or preregistration fail, inspect both records before creating a duplicate appointment.

The managed scheduling capability is useful to evaluate where an appointment continues into an on-site visit. A buyer needing only a standalone meeting link should assess the wider subscription scope. No self-hosting licence, old-to-new entitlement migration, permission, payment or restoration behavior was tested.
sections.zh:
准备站点、服务、主持人、日历连接及访客字段。区分预约访问与员工签到、疏散权限。依赖未到场报告前，应验证提醒及到场匹配。日历写入或预登记失败时，先核对两边记录再创建重复预约。

预约会延续为现场到访的业务，可评估这一托管能力。只需要独立会议链接的买家应判断更广订阅范围是否合适。未测试自托管许可、旧权益迁移、权限、付款或恢复。

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English editorial synthesis and Chinese translation. Examples and evaluation recommendations were not executed.

research_gaps.en: Legacy terms, final tax, bundle metering, calendar/arrival matching, data export, licence and restoration were not tested.
research_gaps.zh: 未测试旧合同、最终税费、预约包计量、日历/到场匹配、导出、许可及恢复。
